original.target_description: Study 2: London undergraduates; BCTI post-manipulation analytic scrambled-sentence prime versus control, independent-samples t-test.

n.quote: The participants of this study were 112 undergraduates
n.sample_role: participants in the target between-condition test
n.exclusions: Six unreachable participants omitted before the final 112; 68 pilot participants excluded from main-study participation.

replication.target_description: Replication Study 1: UK Prolific participants; BCTI post-test analytic scrambled-sentence prime versus control, independent-samples t-test.

n.sample_role: Participants completing both waves and passing quality checks, in primary between-condition BCTI analysis (147 experimental, 155 control).
n.exclusions: 316 completed both waves; 14 removed for failing preregistered quality checks in either wave. Exclusion criteria in §4.1.1.2 include time limit, Prolific approval, attention and bot/fraud checks; no speeders. Separate robustness analyses exclude one outlier or 16 hypothesis guessers and are not the primary test.
n.quote: A total of 316 UK Prolific participants completed both ... one of the two waves (n = 14), we ... were left with N = 302 participants (147 in the experimental and 155 in ... the control condition).

reported_success.quote: Overall, we found no evidence that the analytical prime group ... decreased in belief in conspiracy theories. On the contrary, we found ... evidence for the null hypothesis, i.e., that the scrambled sentence ... analytical priming manipulation did not influence belief in conspiracy ... theories.

notes:
Titles verified against supplied references in both full-text PDFs. Original locator p. 7 uses PDF pagination; replication locator p. 4 uses printed pagination. Main post-test between-condition comparison selected because it prints requested d; not the interaction or within-analytic paired test. A general web search incidentally surfaced forbidden-site snippets; those were not opened or used as extraction evidence.
Completion source review (n_r): Explicit final two-wave participant sample applies to the primary between-condition BCTI comparison; distinct paired and robustness tests not pooled.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly report no replication of the original conspiracy-belief reduction; narrative verdict, not inferred from significance.
